title: Duplicate utility code across src/index.ts and scripts/set-folder-dates.ts — extract to shared module
description: Verified: src/index.ts:49 — stripQuotes function. scripts/set-folder-dates.ts:55 — identical stripQuotes. src/index.ts:51-59 — resolveTargetPath. scripts/set-folder-dates.ts:57-63 — nearly identical resolveTargetPath. src/index.ts:32-47 — parseArgs. scripts/set-folder-dates.ts:32-53 — similar parseArgs with --dry-run addition. Both files independently implement the same path resolution, string stripping, and argument parsing logic. A shared module would eliminate this duplication and create a natural home for future CLI utilities.
spec:
1. Create `src/lib/cli-utils.ts` with exported `stripQuotes`, `resolveTargetPath`, and a base argument parser.
2. Import from the shared module in both src/index.ts and scripts/set-folder-dates.ts.
3. Each consumer keeps its own specialized parseArgs (sync flags vs --dry-run) but delegates shared logic.
4. Update tsconfig.json include array to cover `src/lib/**/*.ts` if needed.
